# Labwise downloads

The old `labwise-pilot.zip` prototype has been replaced by the macOS Apple Silicon application installer.

- [Labwise 1.3.7 DMG](https://github.com/CarryLewis/lab-report-assistant/releases/download/v1.3.7/Labwise-1.3.7-macOS-arm64-trial.dmg)
- [Alternative ZIP](https://github.com/CarryLewis/lab-report-assistant/releases/download/v1.3.7/Labwise-1.3.7-macOS-arm64-trial.zip)
- [Release notes and checksums](https://github.com/CarryLewis/lab-report-assistant/releases/tag/v1.3.7)

The app bundles Python and LibreOffice. Save and quit the previous version before replacing it. This is a local trial build for Apple Silicon, without Developer ID signing or Apple notarization.
